verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own marketing says it supports Rule 701 compliance and Form 3921 filing, and the pricing page lists both as Premium-tier features. There is no detail on how they work: nothing shows Rule 701 disclosure thresholds being monitored or 3921s being generated automatically from cap table data, and 83(b) elections are not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: 83(b) election support, documented automatic Rule 701 threshold tracking, evidence that Form 3921 is generated from cap table data, in-depth how-to docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
